# 无损连接分解判定: 表格法(Chase 算法) + 二元分解的快速判据
def chase(attrs, fds, decomp):
    cols = sorted(attrs)
    idx = {a: i for i, a in enumerate(cols)}
    T = []
    for i, Ri in enumerate(decomp):
        T.append([("a" + a) if a in Ri else ("b%d%s" % (i + 1, a)) for a in cols])
    initial = [list(r) for r in T]
    rounds = 0
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        rounds += 1
        for lhs, rhs in fds:
            lcols = [idx[a] for a in sorted(lhs)]
            groups = {}
            for r in T:
                k = tuple(r[c] for c in lcols)
                groups.setdefault(k, []).append(r)
            for k in sorted(groups):
                rows = groups[k]
                if len(rows) < 2:
                    continue
                for a in sorted(rhs):
                    c = idx[a]
                    vals = [r[c] for r in rows]
                    tgt = None
                    for v in vals:
                        if v.startswith("a"):
                            tgt = v
                            break
                    if tgt is None:
                        tgt = min(vals)
                    for r in rows:
                        if r[c] != tgt:
                            r[c] = tgt
                            changed = True
    lossless = any(all(v.startswith("a") for v in r) for r in T)
    return cols, initial, T, lossless, rounds


def show(cols, T):
    print("      " + "  ".join("%-6s" % c for c in cols))
    for i, r in enumerate(T):
        print("  R%-2d " % (i + 1) + "  ".join("%-6s" % v for v in r))


print("=== 无损连接分解判定 (表格法 / Chase) ===")

print("[用例 1] R(A,B,C,D)  F={A->B, B->C, C->D}   rho={R1(AB), R2(BC), R3(CD)}")
cols, initial, final, ok, rounds = chase({"A", "B", "C", "D"},
                                         [(frozenset("A"), frozenset("B")),
                                          (frozenset("B"), frozenset("C")),
                                          (frozenset("C"), frozenset("D"))],
                                         [{"A", "B"}, {"B", "C"}, {"C", "D"}])
print("  初始表:")
show(cols, initial)
print("  最终表(第 %d 轮收敛):" % rounds)
show(cols, final)
print("  无损连接 = " + ("YES" if ok else "NO") + "   (R1 行全为 a -> 判定成立)")
print()

print("[用例 2] R(A,B,C)  F={A->B, B->C}   rho={R1(AC), R2(BC)}")
cols2, initial2, final2, ok2, rounds2 = chase({"A", "B", "C"},
                                              [(frozenset("A"), frozenset("B")),
                                               (frozenset("B"), frozenset("C"))],
                                              [{"A", "C"}, {"B", "C"}])
print("  初始表:")
show(cols2, initial2)
print("  最终表(第 %d 轮收敛):" % rounds2)
show(cols2, final2)
print("  无损连接 = " + ("YES" if ok2 else "NO") + "   (无全 a 行, 且无法再推导)")
print()

print("[二元分解快速判据] R1∩R2 -> (R1-R2) 或 R1∩R2 -> (R2-R1)")
BIN = [
    ("R(A,B,C) {A->B,B->C}  rho={R1(AB),R2(BC)}",
     [(frozenset("A"), frozenset("B")), (frozenset("B"), frozenset("C"))],
     frozenset("AB"), frozenset("BC")),
    ("R(A,B,C) {A->B,B->C}  rho={R1(AC),R2(BC)}",
     [(frozenset("A"), frozenset("B")), (frozenset("B"), frozenset("C"))],
     frozenset("AC"), frozenset("BC")),
    ("R(A,B,C,D) {A->B,C->D} rho={R1(AB),R2(ACD)}",
     [(frozenset("A"), frozenset("B")), (frozenset("C"), frozenset("D"))],
     frozenset("AB"), frozenset("ACD")),
]
for name, fds, R1, R2 in BIN:
    inter = R1 & R2
    d1, d2 = R1 - R2, R2 - R1
    cl = set(inter)
    ch = True
    while ch:
        ch = False
        for lhs, rhs in fds:
            if lhs <= cl and not rhs <= cl:
                cl |= rhs
                ch = True
    cover1 = d1 <= cl
    cover2 = d2 <= cl
    print("  %s" % name)
    print("     交集=%s  交集+={%s}" % ("+".join(sorted(inter)) or "(空)",
                                        "+".join(sorted(cl)) or ""))
    print("     R1-R2={%s} 被覆盖=%s ; R2-R1={%s} 被覆盖=%s -> 无损连接=%s"
          % ("+".join(sorted(d1)), "YES" if cover1 else "NO",
             "+".join(sorted(d2)), "YES" if cover2 else "NO",
             "YES" if (cover1 or cover2) else "NO"))
